votes.sql:
WITH first_year AS (
    SELECT MIN(move_in_year) AS yr
    FROM Office_locations
    WHERE building_id = (SELECT id FROM buildings WHERE name = 'Torre KOI')
)
SELECT c."Headquarters" AS country
FROM Companies c
JOIN Office_locations o ON c.id = o.company_id
JOIN first_year f ON o.move_in_year = f.yr
GROUP BY c."Headquarters"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
